You are a code worker in the freytag-forge repository at /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge, branch worldkeeper-boundary-moves, already checked out. Do NOT git commit, push, switch branches, stash or revert. Edit ONLY: storygame/runtime/taking.py, tests/test_taking.py, storygame/runtime/seating.py, packages/worldkeeper/src/worldkeeper/model.py, packages/worldkeeper/tests/test_boundary_helpers.py.

BACKGROUND: a firm project rule says world-model logic (anything that reads or changes only world state) lives in packages/worldkeeper as World methods with tests there; storygame only adapts and calls them. The last two commits (git show HEAD~1 and HEAD) moved storygame tree walks into new World helpers. Two leftovers break the rule:

1. storygame/runtime/taking.py `take_before_put` calls `world.takeable_items(...)` but keeps a copy of the old walk behind `if hasattr(world, "takeable_items")`. It exists only because tests/test_taking.py builds a hand-written fake `class World`. Remove the fallback so take_before_put always calls world.takeable_items. Rewrite tests/test_taking.py to use the real worldkeeper World: build a small schema with `WorldSchema.from_data({...})` and `World(schema, MemoryBackend())`, call `seed()`, and use `place`/`move` (see packages/worldkeeper/README.md and packages/worldkeeper/tests/ for style), with entities that reproduce each existing test's scenario (fixed items, vehicles, held items, other areas, the protagonist). Keep every existing test and the meaning of its assertions on take_before_put's result (commands, prose, refusals); the Item/NPC/package stand-ins for the story package may stay. Player commands in tests stay imperative first-person, as they are now.

2. World.reachable_from_seat in packages/worldkeeper returns NAMES (its docstring says "legacy seat-reach names"). A World method returns ids. Make it return entity ids in the same order (World.entity_ids order), rewrite its docstring without the word "legacy", update its tests in packages/worldkeeper/tests/test_boundary_helpers.py, and in storygame/runtime/seating.py `stand_before_leave` map the ids to names with world.name at the call site so needs_to_stand receives exactly the same names as before.

Behaviour seen by the game must not change. HOW TO RUN (never use uv; your sandbox cannot run it): Python is /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/.venv/bin/python with PYTHONPATH set to the repo root and TMPDIR=/tmp. Ruff: .venv/bin/python -m ruff format FILES, then .venv/bin/python -m ruff check FILES.
DONE WHEN `bash /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/scripts/ringer/worldkeeper-boundary/check_round3.sh` prints PASS round 3 (it checks the fallback and fake World are gone, test count did not drop, reachable_from_seat returns ids, and runs about 1,300 focused tests plus ruff).
